Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 10
Reason for Mistake: The Planner failed to recognize that the WebSurfer had already successfully confirmed the critical fact (Springfield became the capital of Illinois in 1839) in the previous step. Instead of synthesizing the available information to provide the final answer, the Planner issued a new set of instructions to the WebSurfer to run the exact same queries again. This created a redundant loop where the agent repeatedly asked for information that was already verified, preventing the conversation from reaching a conclusion. This matches the pattern of "Inadequate recognition and integration of critical information from upstream agent results" seen in Example 4.
